messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 175555: spike in model-init errors in us-west-2. Auto-escalation to #incidents. Error pattern: ELF load fail -> CUDA driver panic.

alice: seeing multiple model load OOMs + deserialize failures on gpu-node-32. restarted container fixed one but others are flapping.

ml-runtime: stack: model-loader v2.3.1. behavior: mmap ELF -> ENOMEM, then nvrtc compile timeout. pushing logs below.

steve-oncall: I'm oncall, taking lead. @eng-sre @eng-runtime pls standby. Rolling temporary reroute to fallback region.

eng-sre: applying reroute: `rbctl route add --model gptx-open --region us-east-1 --priority 10`

eng-runtime: disabling warmup prefetcher on pool. `kubectl -n runtime patch cm warmup-config --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/prefetch","value":false}]'`

alice: logs from gpu-node-32:
```
NVRM: GPU fell off the bus
model-loader: deserialize error: unexpected EOF while reading ELF header
model-compile: nvrtc compile timed out after 60s
```

steve-oncall: temp mitigation: disable precompile + reduce batch size to 1 for affected routes. `rbctl config set --route /v1/generate --max_batch 1 --precompile false --regions us-west-2`

customer-ops-bot: Customer impact alert: Dedicated accounts affected: AcmeCorp, DataStream Inc. ~12% query failures in last 10m. Notifying SOC contacts.

alice: metrics: 5xx rate us-west-2 jumped 0.2% -> 4.6% in 10m. High correlation with model 'gptx-open' warmups.

eng-sre: suspicion: corrupted artifact on NFS causing repeated deserialization attempts -> GPU driver panic. Kicking cache invalidation: `artctl invalidate --path /models/gptx-open/2025-03-10/artifact.tar`

ml-runtime: plan: 1) quarantine nodes labeled 'gpu-fell-off'; 2) rebuild artifact on warm bucket; 3) restart warmers gradually with prefetch disabled. Starting artifact rebuild now.

steve-oncall: handing off to @eve in 30m. Current status: fallback routing active, precompile disabled, cache invalidation started. Customer impact limited by reroute; continue monitoring. :white_check_mark:

eve: ack, taking over. Will coordinate postmortem and customer comms. Ping me for escalations.

incident-bot: UPDATE: mitigation applied. Monitoring for 30m. If error rate recovers we'll close. :white_check_mark:
